_comment: MariaDB / MySQL overlay. Apply with --profile mariadb. Arrays APPEND to the base config; EDIT the data bind 'source' to a host path (it must exist). See profiles/README.md.
_comment_env: Set MARIADB_ROOT_PASSWORD (or MARIADB_ALLOW_EMPTY_ROOT_PASSWORD / MARIADB_RANDOM_ROOT_PASSWORD) in the container's registry 'env' - NOT here, this file is shared. TZ is a convenience.
_comment_shm: A little shared memory for the InnoDB / temp tables; raise if you tune the buffer pool high.
